README, BUT MAKE IT SHORT

It's hammer time.

Coral bugs are worth 10 points. Purple bugs are worth 25. Mint robots are friends: hitting one costs 20 points.

Every five bugs in a row adds a multiplier, up to 5×. A missed bug, an empty key or a bonked bot breaks the streak. An empty hit costs 5 points.

Catch six bugs to charge Bot Buddy. Press Space or the buddy button to clear the bugs on screen. Your robot friends are safe.
